symptom: Machine is Not Steered Well or Steering Power is Low
detail_of_failure: Machine is not steered correctly or steering power is low
related_information: Pre-troubleshooting If a failure code is shown, do the troubleshooting for that code first. Monitoring code • Travel PPC pressure can be examined with the monitoring function. (Code: 01882) • Merge-divider Main Sol Current can be examined with the monitoring function. (Code: 08000) • Merge-divider LS Sol Current can be examined with the monitoring function. (Code: 08001)

Is the junction valve spool clean, with no twisting, seizure, scratches, or dirt? (It must move smoothly and not be stuck.) REMARK Be careful that dirt does not enter during recovery work.

branches.YES: • The travel junction valve is normal. • Go to the next check item.
branches.NO: • The travel junction valve is defective. • Repair or replace the travel junction valve. • Go to “Confirmation of repair”.

steps.procedure: 1. Stop the engine. 2. Release the pressure that remains in the hydraulic tank and piping. For details, see Testing and Adjusting, “Release Remained Pressure in Hydraulic Circuit”. 3. Take out the oil pressure sensor mounting port (PP1S) of front pump, and install the hydraulic multimeter. 4. Run the engine with fuel control dial at Hi, and set the work equipment control lever in NEU- TRAL or bucket CURL relief or arm IN relief to troubleshoot. 5. Does the troubleshooting result of the LS-EPC output pressure agree with the standard value? 6. After troubleshooting, restore them. 7. Show the Merge-divider LS Sol Current screen. For details, see Testing and Adjusting How to Examine Monitoring Information of “Service Mode”. 8. Operate the work equipment lever to do the troubleshooting. 9. Does the EPC current result agree with the standard value? Measurement position, condi- Standard val- Item tion ue

steps.cause: Pressure compensation valve on the right FORWARD side of the travel control valve
steps.procedure: 1. Interchange the pressure compensation valves on the right FORWARD side and right REVERSE side of the right travel control valve to do the troubleshooting. 2. Is there no change, and does the phenomenon reproduce?

branches.YES: • Pressure compensation valve on R.H. front side of travel control valve is normal. • Go to the next check item.
branches.NO: • Pressure compensation valve on R.H. front side of travel control valve is defective. • Repair or replace the pressure compensation valve on the R.H. front side of the travel control valve. • Go to “Confirmation of repair”.

steps.cause: Pressure compensation valve on the right REVERSE side of the travel control valve
steps.procedure: 1. Interchange the pressure compensation valves on the right REVERSE side and right FORWARD side of the right travel control valve to do the troubleshooting. 2. Is there no change, and does the phenomenon reproduce?

branches.YES: • Pressure compensation valve on R.H. rear side of travel control valve is normal. • Go to the next check item.
branches.NO: • Pressure compensation valve on R.H. rear side of travel control valve is defective. • Repair or replace the pressure compensation valve on the right REVERSE side of the travel control valve. • Go to “Confirmation of repair”.

steps.cause: Safety valve of R.H. travel motor
steps.procedure: 1. Interchange the forward and reverse safety valves of the right and left travel motors and do the troubleshooting. 2. Is there no change, and does the phenomenon reproduce?

branches.YES: • Safety valve of R.H. travel motor is normal. • Go to the next check item.
branches.NO: • Safety valve of R.H. travel motor is defective. • Repair or replace the safety valve of the R.H. travel motor. • Go to “Confirmation of repair”.

steps.cause: Suction valve of R.H. travel control valve
steps.procedure: 1. Release the pressure that remains in the hydraulic tank and piping. For details, see Testing and Adjusting, “Release Remained Pressure in Hydraulic Circuit”. 2. Adjust the relief valve. 3. Do the troubleshooting. For details, see Testing and Adjusting, “Examine and Adjust Oil Pressure in Work Equipment, Swing, and Travel Circuits”. 4. Is the oil pressure difference between the front and rear ports equal?

branches.YES: • The suction valve of the right travel control valve is normal. • Go to the next check item.
branches.NO: • The suction valve of the right travel control valve is defective. • Repair or replace the suction valve of the R.H. travel control valve. • Go to “Confirmation of repair”.
